title: interlock-shift-handshake-and-rollout-concordance-2026-11-draft
content:
Context:
This is a working draft for an explicit release <-> SRE handshake ritual focused on 'sundown' / quiet-window rollouts where locality tuning and telemetry sensitivity matter (NA/EU/APAC overlap). Goal is to create a predictable sequence so on-call and release teams have the same mental model and a compact checklist for fast decisions.

High-level goals:
- Keep user-facing latency within SLOs while phasing traffic across regions.
- Limit blast radius via locality splits and progressive ramp.
- Give SRE a short, actionable telemetry checklist to validate health at each step.
- Capture release notes skeleton and rollback triggers in a single doc for quick copy-paste to Slack/Status.

Planned release window (UTC):
- Canary start: 2026-11-10 22:00 UTC (regional staging -> 1% NA)
- Locality ramp: 2026-11-10 23:00 UTC -> 2026-11-11 04:00 UTC (increment to 25% NA, add EU at 01:00 UTC)
- Full daylight completion: 2026-11-11 08:00 UTC (target 95% global)
Notes: times chosen to avoid APAC morning spike; double-check partner jobs scheduled at 23:30 UTC.

Preflight checklist (must be green before Canary start):
- [ ] Release artifacts built and checksum-verified (CI artifact sha: attach in release channel).
- [ ] Canary AMI/container image tagged and pushed (PR #2345 attached).
- [ ] Smoke-run deck executed against staging (smoke id: smoke/2026-11-09-7).
- [ ] Canary observability: dashboards for latency, 5xx rate, QPS, error-class breakdown ready in 'release-sandbox' view.
- [ ] Canary Slack channel created: #release-interlock-2026-11 (invite SRE rota + release owner).
- [ ] Pager duty escalation pinned in channel and included in handoff message.
- [ ] Postgres/Redis schema migrations: none OR migrations run in preflight (if present note rollback path).
- [ ] Feature flags set for canary gating and locality splits.
- [ ] Ops runbook snippet (this doc) copied to channel + pinned.

Handshake ritual (30m before canary):
- Release owner posts compact rundown: artifact sha, target regions, expected traffic split, known limitations.
- SRE lead acknowledges and posts the telemetry checklist and four baseline numbers (latency P50/P95, 5xx rate, backend queue depth).
- Quick smoke: 5 synthetic requests in each region (NA/EU/APAC) reported inline.
- If any baseline deviates by >10% vs baseline snapshot, hold and run deep-smoke.

Locality tuning & rollout cadence (clockwork):
- Step 0 (canary): 1% NA only for 30m. Telemetry checks identical to full runbook but faster cadence (5m checks).
- Step 1: 5% NA + 0% EU/APAC (30m). If healthy -> Step 2.
- Step 2: 25% NA + 1% EU (60m). Add EU because we observe similar latency curves.
- Step 3: 50% NA + 10% EU + 1% APAC (120m). Watch cross-region fallbacks (route anomalies).
- Step 4: 95% global (progressive within 2h).
Notes: locality split method = smart-router route by region header -> target pool. If smart-router not available, use load balancer weight override (see ops-weights playbook).

Telemetry quick-commands (SRE shorthand) - run immediately after each step and every 15m during critical ramps:
- Query A: rolling_5m_errors(service=platform-api,env=canary) -> alert if >0.5%
- Query B: p95_latency(service=tokenizer,route=/generate) -> alert if >+30% vs baseline
- Query C: backend_queue_depth(by_host) -> alert if any host > 80% of capacity
- Query D: tail_retries_and_fallbacks(last_30m) -> expect near-zero; investigate >5 events
- Query E: token_cost_rate and per-token throughput -> detect sudden unit-cost spikes (possible regression)
Tip: paste those as saved queries in the pinned channel to avoid typos.

Rollback & escape hatch matrix (fast actions):
- Condition: 5xx spike > 1% sustained for 10m -> Action: immediate 50% traffic rollback to previous model pool + open incident ticket.
- Condition: p95 latency > +50% for 15m -> Action: throttle rollout (pause) and revert newly added pool if no improvement in 10m.
- Condition: backend queue depth overflow / host OOM -> Action: scale up emergency pool (pre-warmed), shift 100% to stable pool.
- Communication: release owner posts 'ROLLBACK START' with timestamp, reason, and link to playbook.

Operator checklist during ramp (for the on-call):
- Every 5m in first 30m of each step: run Query A + Query B and paste summarized numbers.
- Every 15m during long ramps: run Query C + Query D.
- If any anomaly, tag the release owner and SRE lead (@sre-lead).
- Document each anomalous event in the channel with timestamp, raw metric snapshot, and actions taken.

Release notes (working bullets for product + ops):
- New: regional locality-aware routing that reduces cross-region tail latency by preferring local pools. (Tech: locality-scheduler v2)
- Improved: dynamic batching heuristics for short sequences to reduce per-token CPU by ~12% in NA canary.
- Notes: initial rollout limited to % traffic per-region; customers may see shorter cold-starts in their region.

Customer-impact escalation guideline:
- If >2 SEV2 reports in first 2h -> open incident bridge, escalate to on-call manager.
- If >1 SEV1 -> immediate global rollback and all-hands.

Calendar (compact):
- 2026-11-09: final smoke in staging, tag image, preflight green-checks.
- 2026-11-10 21:30 UTC: preflight handshake call (15m) + pin runbook.
- 2026-11-10 22:00 UTC: canary start (1% NA).
- 2026-11-11 08:00 UTC: target completion (95% global).

Post-release debrief (what to write down within 2h after completion):
- Actual ramp times and deviations from plan.
- Any anomalies and root-cause hints (attach logs/graphs).
- Exact rollback events (if any) and timing.
- Cost delta observed during ramp (token cost / instance-hours).
- Three quick wins for next rollout (short bullets).

Open questions (TODOs):
- Q1: Should we formalize a 'twilight' metric window specifically for sundown rollouts (recommendation: 90m post-step observation)?
- Q2: Confirm whether partner batch jobs at 23:30 UTC run on same infra - If yes, shift our timeline by 30m. @Jordan to confirm.
- Q3: Add a short-run synthetic for function-calling paths (we currently only synthetic text-gen).

Notes-to-self (draft, keep informal):
- Keep this doc minimal; link to larger 'rollout-concordance' playbook for deep details.
- We should try a micro-campaign next week (50% NA -> 100% NA in 3 steps) to validate locality heuristics without touching EU/APAC.
- Remember to attach the PR diff and the canary image sha in the pinned message.

Appendix: quick copy templates (paste to Slack)
- Preflight post (short): "PRE-FLIGHT: canary image sha=sha256:aaa... target=NA1 22:00UTC. SRE please ack telemetry checks: p50/p95/5xx/queue."
- Rollout progress: "STEP 2 -> 25% NA + 1% EU @2026-11-10T23:45Z. Telemetry: p95=120ms (+8%), 5xx=0.12% -> OK"
- Rollback start: "ROLLBACK START @timestamp reason=5xx-spike details=<link-to-metric> owner=@MayaChen"

-- end of draft --

(If you are reading this and have suggestions, please add inline comments or drop a line in #release-interlock-2026-11)
